people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
translations.bsb: The crowd admonished them to be silent, but they cried out all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
translations.kjv: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
translations.asv: And the multitude rebuked them, that they should hold their peace: but they cried out the more, saying, Lord, have mercy on us, thou son of David.
